sentences.en: A The market for tourism in remote areas is booming as never before.
sentences.zh: 边远地区的旅游市场比以往任何时候都更加繁荣。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Countries all across the world are actively promoting their ‘wilderness’ regions – such as mountains, Arctic lands, deserts, small islands and wetlands – to high-spending tourists.
sentences.zh: 全世界各国都在积极向高消费游客宣传自己的“迷茫”区域,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The attraction of these areas is obvious: by definition, wilderness tourism requires little or no initial investment.
sentences.zh: 这些地区的吸引力显而易见:根据定义,野外旅游几乎不需要或不需要初始投资。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: But that does not mean that there is no cost.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着没有费用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: As the 1992 United Nations Conference on Environment and Development recognized, these regions are fragile (i.e. highly vulnerable to abnormal pressures) not just in terms of their ecology, but also in terms of the culture of their inhabitants.
sentences.zh: 正如1992年联合国环境与发展会议所确认,这些地区不仅在生态方面,而且在居民的文化方面都很脆弱(即极易受到异常压力的影响)。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The three most significant types of fragile environment in these respects, and also in terms of the proportion of the Earth’s surface they cover, are deserts, mountains and Arctic areas.
sentences.zh: 在上述方面,以及就其覆盖的地球表面比例而言,三种最重大的脆弱环境类型是沙漠、山区和北极地区。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: An important characteristic is their marked seasonality, with harsh conditions prevailing for many months each year.
sentences.zh: 一个重要的特点是它们的季节性明显,每年有好几个月的恶劣条件。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Consequently, most human activities, including tourism, are limited to quite clearly defined parts of the year.
sentences.zh: 因此,包括旅游业在内的多数人类活动仅限于一年中相当明确界定的部分。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Tourists are drawn to these regions by their natural landscape beauty and the unique cultures of their indigenous people.
sentences.zh: 游客们从自然景观美景和土著人民的独特文化吸引到这些地区。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: And poor governments in these isolated areas have welcomed the new breed of ‘adventure tourist’, grateful for the hard currency they bring.
sentences.zh: 而这些孤立地区的贫穷政府欢迎新一品种的“冒险旅游者”, 感谢他们带来的硬通货。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For several years now, tourism has been the prime source of foreign exchange in Nepal and Bhutan.
sentences.zh: 几年来,旅游业一直是尼泊尔和不丹外汇的主要来源。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Tourism is also a key element in the economies of Arctic zones such as Lapland and Alaska and in desert areas such as Ayers Rock in Australia and Arizona’s Monument Valley.
sentences.zh: 旅游业也是拉普兰和阿拉斯加等北极地区经济以及澳大利亚的艾尔斯岩和亚利桑那州古迹谷等沙漠地区经济的一个关键因素。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: B Once a location is established as a main tourist destination, the effects on the local community are profound.
sentences.zh: B 一旦将一个地点确定为主要旅游目的地,对当地社区的影响就会十分深远。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: When hill-farmers, for example, can make more money in a few weeks working as porters for foreign trekkers than they can in a year working in their fields, it is not surprising that many of them give up their farm-work, which is thus left to other members of the family.
sentences.zh: 例如,山地农民在几个星期内可以挣更多的钱,当外国旅行者当搬运工,比在田地工作一年挣得更多,因此,他们中许多人放弃农业劳动,让家庭其他成员做。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: In some hill-regions, this has led to a serious decline in farm output and a change in the local diet, because there is insufficient labour to maintain terraces and irrigation systems and tend to crops.
sentences.zh: 在一些山区,这导致农业产量严重下降,当地饮食发生变化,因为没有足够的劳动力维持梯田和灌溉系统,并倾向于种植作物。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The result has been that many people in these regions have turned to outside supplies of rice and other foods.
sentences.zh: 结果,这些地区的许多人转向外部供应大米和其他粮食。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In Arctic and desert societies, year-round survival has traditionally depended on hunting animals and fish and collecting fruit over a relatively short season.
sentences.zh: 在北极和沙漠社会,全年的生存传统上依靠狩猎动物和鱼类,在较短的季节里采集水果。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: However, as some inhabitants become involved in tourism, they no longer have time to collect wild food; this has led to increasing dependence on bought food and stores.
sentences.zh: 然而,由于一些居民参与旅游业,他们不再有时间收集野生食物;这导致对购买食品和商店的依赖程度日益提高。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Tourism is not always the culprit behind such changes.
sentences.zh: 旅游业并不总是造成这种变化的罪魁祸首。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: All kinds of wage labour, or government handouts, tend to undermine traditional survival systems.
sentences.zh: 各种有薪劳动或政府施舍往往破坏传统的生存系统。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Whatever the cause, the dilemma is always the same: what happens if these new, external sources of income dry up?
sentences.zh: 无论原因为何,两难处境总是相同的:如果这些新的外来收入来源枯竭,会怎样?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The physical impact of visitors is another serious problem associated with the growth in adventure tourism.
sentences.zh: 游客的实际影响是冒险旅游增长引起的另一个严重问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Much attention has focused on erosion along major trails, but perhaps more important are the deforestation and impacts on water supplies arising from the need to provide tourists with cooked food and hot showers.
sentences.zh: 注意力主要集中在主要通道的侵蚀,但也许更重要的是森林砍伐和由于需要向游客提供烹饪食品和热水淋浴而对供水的影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In both mountains and deserts, slow-growing trees are often the main sources of fuel and water supplies may be limited or vulnerable to degradation through heavy use.
sentences.zh: 在山区和沙漠,生长缓慢的树木往往是燃料的主要来源,供水可能有限,或因使用量大而容易退化。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: C Stories about the problems of tourism have become legion in the last few years.
sentences.zh: 过去几年来,关于旅游问题的C故事已成为一个团。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Yet it does not have to be a problem.
sentences.zh: 然而,这不一定非得是一个问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Although tourism inevitably affects the region in which it takes place, the costs to these fragile environments and their local cultures can be minimized.
sentences.zh: 虽然旅游业不可避免地影响到旅游所在的区域,但可以尽量减少这些脆弱环境及其当地文化的代价。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Indeed, it can even be a vehicle for reinvigorating local cultures, as has happened with the Sherpas of Nepal’s Khumbu Valley and in some Alpine villages.
sentences.zh: 也像尼泊尔昆布谷的谢尔帕斯(Sherpas)和阿尔卑斯山的一些村庄一样。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: And a growing number of adventure tourism operators are trying to ensure that their activities benefit the local population and environment over the long term.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的冒险旅游经营者正努力确保他们的活动长期造福于当地民众和环境。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In the Swiss Alps, communities have decided that their future depends on integrating tourism more effectively with the local economy.
sentences.zh: 在瑞士阿尔卑斯山,社区决定,他们的未来取决于能否更有效地将旅游业与当地经济结合起来。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Local concern about the rising number of second home developments in the Swiss Pays d’Enhaut resulted in limits being imposed on their growth.
sentences.zh: 当地对瑞士Enhaut工资公司第二套住房开发数量不断增加的关切导致对住房增长施加限制。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: There has also been a renaissance in communal cheese production in the area, providing the locals with a reliable source of income that does not depend on outside visitors.
sentences.zh: 该地区的社区奶酪生产也出现了复兴,为当地人提供了可靠的收入来源,而这种来源并不依赖外来游客。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Many of the Arctic tourist destinations have been exploited by outside companies, who employ transient workers and repatriate most of the profits to their home base.
sentences.zh: 北极的许多旅游目的地受到外部公司的剥削,这些公司雇用临时工人,将大部分利润汇回自己的家乡。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: But some Arctic communities are now operating tour businesses themselves, thereby ensuring that the benefits accrue locally.
sentences.zh: 但是,一些北极社区现在自己经营旅游企业,从而确保当地能够从中获益。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For instance, a native corporation in Alaska, employing local people, is running an air tour from Anchorage to Kotzebue, where tourists eat Arctic food, walk on the tundra and watch local musicians and dancers.
sentences.zh: 例如,阿拉斯加的一家雇用当地人的本地公司正在从安克雷奇到科兹布埃进行空中巡视,游客在那里吃北极食物,在苔原上行走,看当地音乐家和舞蹈家。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Native people in the desert regions of the American Southwest have followed similar strategies, encouraging tourists to visit their pueblos and reservations to purchase high-quality handicrafts and artwork.
sentences.zh: 美国西南部沙漠地区的土著人也采取了类似的战略,鼓励游客参观他们的小屋,并预订购买高质量的手工艺品和艺术品。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The Acoma and San Ildefonso pueblos have established highly profitable pottery businesses, while the Navajo and Hopi groups have been similarly successful with jewellery.
sentences.zh: Acoma和San Ildefonso Pueblos建立了利润高的陶器企业,Navajo和Hopi团体在珠宝业也取得了同样的成功。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Too many people living in fragile environments have lost control over their economies, their culture and their environment when tourism has penetrated their homelands.
sentences.zh: 当旅游业渗透到自己的家园时,太多生活在脆弱环境中的人失去了对其经济、文化和环境的控制。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Merely restricting tourism cannot be the solution to the imbalance, because people’s desire to see new places will not just disappear.
sentences.zh: 仅仅限制旅游并不能解决不平衡问题,因为人们希望看到新的地方的愿望不会消失。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Instead, communities in fragile environments must achieve greater control over tourism ventures in their regions; in order to balance their needs and aspirations with the demands of tourism.
sentences.zh: 相反,脆弱环境中的社区必须对其所在区域的旅游企业实行更大的控制;以便平衡其需求和愿望与旅游业的需求。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A growing number of communities are demonstrating that, with firm communal decision-making, this is possible.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的社区正在证明,通过坚定的社区决策,这是可能的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The critical question now is whether this can become the norm, rather than the exception.
sentences.zh: 现在的关键问题是,这能否成为常规,而不是例外。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

items.prompt: The low financial cost of setting up wilderness tourism makes it attractive to many countries.
Deserts, mountains and Arctic regions are examples of environments that are both ecologically and culturally fragile.
Wilderness tourism operates throughout the year in fragile areas.
The spread of tourism in certain hill-regions has resulted in a fall in the amount of food produced locally.
Traditional food-gathering in desert societies was distributed evenly over the year.
Government handouts do more damage than tourism does to traditional patterns of food-gathering.
